query: Visual inputs in the superficial layers of the SC correspond to the organized projections from the retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) in the retina (the retino-collicular (RC) projections) and from layer V neurons in the primary visual cortex V1 (the cortico-collicular [CC] projections).
